integrity: General proof is self-contained. Exact finite checker tests chambers and witnesses as supplementary evidence, not an infinite proof. Full text of the 2013 graph morphology paper was not obtained; an older equivalent theorem cannot be ruled out.
limitations: Finite real cyclic signals only, n>=3, strictly positive first-variation edge weights and forward two-site max/min; no assertion for three-site or larger morphology, arbitrary graphs, continuous BV, higher-order variations or external priority certification.
title: Sharp two-wall variation law for one-sided cyclic dilation
